patch_list: Removes the Yamby Pro row from Settings. Pro features remain unlocked by the Unlock Pro patch.
Unlocks all Yamby Pro features by seeding a local licence code, making the client-side HMAC comparator accept it, and forcing the cached list-animation entitlement flag. No Play purchase is required.
